info.title: Aero Zenith Flow API
info.description:
Space Scope backend. JSON responses use `{ data, meta }`; errors use `{ error, meta }`.

Authentication endpoints under `/api/auth/*` are served by Better Auth and follow its protocol.

Health probes (`/health/live`, `/health/ready`) return a fixed `{ status }` shape.

get.summary: Roles, memberships and the app-gate status for the signed-in user
Server-sent events: `changed` whenever the caller's roles or memberships change

200.description: Event stream: `ready` on connect, `changed` on access changes, comment heartbeats every 25s

sprintId.description: Omit to keep the sprint; null moves to the backlog

afterTicketId.description: Ticket that will precede this one

beforeTicketId.description: Ticket that will follow this one

userId.description: Managers may log for another person
Managers may log for another person

allowEmpty.description: True when files will be attached

duplicate.description: True when a pending invitation already covers this email and scope; nothing was sent

body.description: Serialized TipTap JSON or legacy text

callbackUrl.description: OAuth redirect URI registered in Atlassian

authorizeUrl.description: Atlassian consent URL; open it in a popup or tab

JiraOAuthCallbackPage.description: Browser redirect target. Responds with a small text/html page (not the JSON envelope) that notifies the opener window and closes, or redirects to the app's /jira page.
